title: Bug: React 19 significant performance regression with many <input> elements
author: elakov
body_preview: After upgrading to React 19, I observed a significant performance regression during the commit phase. The slowdown occurs specifically when a render touches \<input\> elements.  The new updateInput logic in React 19 does not check whether the DOM actually needs to be updated.
